'''General Syndulla's camp''' was a camp set up in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|rebel]] [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]] on the [[moon]] [[Endor]]. [[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]] were sent to the camp by [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] to speak to Syndulla in order to get [[ration bar]]s from her, so that they can give them to the [[Ewok]]s to prevent them from eating captured [[stormtrooper]]s.<ref name="An Imperial Feast" />
